notes.title: Subterrain: Mines of Titan Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8292342/b03d0d60656b7afdfd5ea56ef2c1f189014ad597.png

Hi Everyone!

For those of you who cares and been waiting for the Subterrain: Mines of Titan news, today we have a great announcement to make!

It's has been really tough 3 years of making this game and our while our journey was not easy, it was certainly been fun and rewarding learning experience. And today, we are so excited to give you official release date for the game!

Subterrain: Mines of Titan is set to launch on March 12th, and the time for survival is nigh! We cannot wait for you to descend into the depths with us, and have a BRAND NEW trailer for our announcement for you: 

[previewyoutube=NF3GxWxd594;full]https://youtu.be/NF3GxWxd594[/previewyoutube]

A heartfelt thank you to everyone who's been part of this incredible journey over the last 3+ years of development. The mystery of Titan beckons, and we can't wait for you to uncover its secrets. 

Subterrain: Mines of Titan

🔍 Uncover the Secrets of Titan:

Embark on a quest of survival as you confront the lurking horrors below. Will you craft equipment, research new gear, fight against overwhelming odds, or uncover your true fate? Titan, an unrelenting world, demands your resilience, and every step you take advances time. Only you can intervene to prevent the collapse of Camp Huygens.

🌑 Survival Management:
Survive the unforgiving environment of Titan by managing resources, tracking time, and exploring abandoned mining tunnels. The fate of Camp Huygens rests on your shoulders.

⚔️ Turn-Based Combat:
Confront monstrous foes with brisk, intuitive turn-based combat. Choose your approach—close and personal or strategic plinking from afar. Harness the power of nanomachines, evolve alongside creatures, and adapt tactics to conquer Titan's mines.

🔧 Crafting System:
Craft an arsenal of items, salvage materials, and produce tools, weapons, protective gear, explosives, and survival upgrades. Enhance yourself with medical supplies and continue research to unearth the terrible truth.


🚨 Join the Countdown:
Wishlist Subterrain: Mines of Titan now to be among the first to brave the depths. 📆🔔

🌐 Stay Connected:
Join our community on Discord, and follow us on Twitter for updates and exclusive insights.

The countdown to survival begins! Get ready to descend into the abyss.

Please support us by following and wish listing the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1573100/Subterrain_Mines_of_Titan/

Until launch,
Pixellore🛠️🔦

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8292342/1e455594cd9bdb57f9e36b132f73326eee4c8dc6.png

Hello everyone!

We are happy to announce that the public demo for the Subterrain Mines of Titan will be released a bit earlier than the official Steam Next date.

It will be released around 10 PDT time on 2nd of June.

We still think the demo is not yet 100% ready, but we wanted to release it sooner so that the press can play the demo ahead of the Steam Fest.

We will still be updating the demo all the way to the main game release.

This is very exciting, yet very nervous time for us, and we are expecting a lot of feedback and bugs to popping up! So please do give us any feedback, bug report by Steam forum or at our Discord channel.

Thank you and we are looking forward to hearing from you!

Release Note : Version 1151 20 Oct 2016

BETA 

- Fixed : Spanish tutorial controller image had missing texts

- Fixed : UI button images for the controller was not changing correctly upon connection/disconnection. (1150 bug)

Release Note : Version 1150 19 Oct 2016

BETA 

- Fixed : West not disappearing first before tube door closes. 

- Fixed : Researching small bag wasn't giving the ability to produce one itself. 

- Updated : Remote control access has been changed so that only Hardcore and Nightmare difficulty mode has the restriction of needing level 2 software. 

- Updated : Slightly updated base layout. Added new repair machine (slots still shared) near the generator room. Added research remote control machines. This will only apply for the new games that starts with version 1150. This means everything is accessible completely from the base. 

- Updated : There is whole new set of useful location icons for data chips and other mission critical items. This shows on the minimap regardless of map fog exploration status. This will help a lot to not miss the critical items. 

There are few conditions for the icons to appear on the map. 

1. West needs to have obtained and read relevant log journal entries before the icons show on the map. 

2. West needs to have at least visited the same area map as the icon. ie : icons will not show for the maps that West has never been to. This is enforced by the fact that West can't view any maps that he has not been to. 

This new feature can be toggled in the settings file under "miniMap", This option will eventually make its way to the options menu, but localization needs to be sorted out first. 

Localization change : 
Added : speech_facility_research_noremote 

Thanks!

notes.title: Upcoming Soundtrack DLC and Deluxe version.
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

People has suggested to create Sound track DLC and I thought it was a great idea! so it is coming soon on 26th May!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/470670/

I know it isn't a content update, but if you would like to support the development , be the update for the Subterrain or the next game from Pixellore, please feel free to buy it.

I am also working on a deluxe version of the game with the DLC as the same purchase with a bit of discount when bought together. I am working on it to be released at the same time as the OST DLC.

Lighting system update
As for the update of the game, I am currently working hard on the all new lighting system that I wanted to do for very long time which will boost rendering performance a lot. I have almost finished it and I will release it as usual beta branch first.

Optimization and code refactoring
There is a lots of work under way for the preparation to port the game to different platforms. The platforms that I am going to port the game to are :
Xbox One, PS4 and possibly Linux and Mac release.

Bug fixes and localization
Usual bug fixes while refactorying the code base and I am looking to polish up the localization as well.

I have not been updating the game as often as I used to , and that is because the new lighting system rework takes long time to do. But I think it was worth it!

As always, thanks for the support and I hope to post another news soon!

notes.title: Major content update release!
notes.notes:
Major content update code name "Purification" is now released!

Without too much spoiler, the update is all about: 


Extended game play that let you experience personal story line of Dr.West.
Epic boss battles with heart pounding new music scores!
Better overall game play experience by the tightening up the previous first part of the game.
Random floor generation. Now the important items are found in randomly shuffled floors.
Voice over for the all cut scenes!
More achievements and leaderboard types.
More endings!
Many other minor bug fixes over the previous version.


http://i.imgur.com/lyrUgpM.jpg

Check out the new trailer here or at the Subterrain store : 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qNKtVA__7Tc

As we have promised, it is a free update to those of you who has bought the game already. No DLC stuff!

We really hope you enjoy the extended version of the game!

I would like to thank those of you who has contributed directly and indirectly to the update. It would not have been possible without your efforts! You guys rule!

Previous save game is more or less compatible with the updated game if the version the game has started isn't too old. I think any save game that has started since version 107x should be ok.

However, it is always best and safe to play the new game from the beginning.

Thank you! and if you have any questions just let us know in the forum as always.

notes.title: Purification official update date
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone.

I would like to move the beta version of the purification update to default game on 4th of May.

There still be some bugs and polishing to do and localization is not yet completed, but I want to move on so that more players can play it.

This means that the price of the game will be up by $2 on 4th of May.

I hope this update can really bring some better experience for everyone.

I would also like to thank to those of you who visited us on PAX EAST game show.

I am currently making a new trailer that goes with the purification update and that will be uploaded as well.

After the purification update, I want to just focus on the bug fixing and platform support such as Linux or Mac port and the other console ports.

There will not be anymore update as far as the contents goes. As much as I love to continue developing Subterrain, I have to find the way to make living and that means I have to try and port the game to the other platforms as soon as I can.

I have very exciting other projects in mind and I will be more than willing to share them with the community of Subterrain.

Thank you and if you have any problems with purification update, just give me a shout.

notes.title: Purification update beta test
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I am looking for the players who are willing to help us do beta testing of the coming updated content.

Please check the details here : 

http://steamcommunity.com/app/340490/discussions/0/365163686050773458/

We have been thinking hard about how we will be delivering the update. And there were choice of doing DLC or just updating the original game base with the new content.

After a lot of thinking it through, we have decided not to go with the DLC and just update the original game with the content. This means that we will not be charging the existing players with the new contents. When we originally set out to do the update, we wanted existing players to not having to pay for the future updates, so this is our way of keeping the promise.

However, we have invested a significant amount of time and efforts to update the game, so we believe that the base price of the game needs to be up a little.

So after the beta testing, we would like to raise small $2 on top of our original price making it $16.99 once the update becomes official.

We want to make the update official as soon as possible and before mid April so purchasing game before that is a $2 save at least!

We will announce more detail about this soon as well.

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Update 1042
notes.notes:
We are working through series of BETA builds to fix some bugs and working on the major purification update. There will be separate purification branch to test that update for the invited party. More news on this will follow.

Thanks!

Release Note : Version 1042 24 Feb 2016

 BETA 

- Fixed : Sometimes tram won't arrive (but you can still spawn on the platform.

- Fixed : Strange Viking plaza show cases not lootable bug. I still don't know what causes it but I have implemented safe measure to correct it after the game's load.

- Fixed : Turret status label localization position issue.

- Updated : Item description can now have line breaker. Thanks for the suggestion!

- Updated : Dragging items from inventory into tactical slots will now work regardless of the item category. This is new feature so it is subject to some bugs.

- Updated : Infection rate calculation has changed a bit. The locations has better min o2 and temperature and it has some effects on the infection rate. The old save games may have some wrong values in them. But all future new games should have this update.

Release Note : Version 1041 24 Feb 2016

 BETA 

- Fixed : Cancelling crafting process only returned materials for 1 item.

- Updated : Updated various localization files. Thanks guys.

We are in the middle of creating purification update. So there "could" be some bugs creeping into the game while we are adding the features and polishing them.

Release Note : Version 1040 21 Feb 2016

- Fixed : Another attempt to fix forever invasion. It should always end invasion now.

Release Note : Version 1039 20 Feb 2016

 BETA 

- Fixed : Another attempt to fix "Box" title for the containers. These fixes may not work properly for other types (eg dumpsters)

- Updated : Vsync option now requires a restart to prevent losing mapping on some computer.

- Updated : Attempt to make minimap rendering faster by reducing texture size from 2k to 1k. This is experimental.

- Updated : Item detail stats description can now be in multi line.

- Updated : Removed a room design that can cause disappearing of its funiture objects.

Release Note : Version 1038 19 Feb 2016

 BETA 

- Fixed : Player icon not disappearing when hud minimap transparency was set to 0.

- Fixed : Mine and farm queue had wrong queue limit text on level 4.

- Fixed : Wrong icon sprite for vodka.

- Fixed : Wrong icon for the crafting facilities.

- Fixed : Possible fix for localization issue for the container titles.

- Updated : Switch around crafting facilities so they are more consistent with the others.

- Updated : New wall rendering for minimap! I think part of the reason why some people are having difficult times locating the chips etc is that the minimap could sometimes be over looked so that the player was thinking they had explored the area. Now with wall rendering this confusion will be greatly reduced. However, this comes at the cost of some performance. Nothing modern pc can't handle, but it still needs to render the walls again.

- Updated : Changed fog texture format from jpg to png file. This could reduce save game size a bit in some cases and produces better loseless fog maps. This change was required for the minimap wall rendering.

notes.notes:
Just came back from Taipei game show!

It was cool to visite Taiwan and check out many other cool games and meet other developers. But I am sure I will need to get back to much needed updates so here they are!

Release Note : Version 1.0.1.3  30 Jan 2016

- Updated : Changed mouse cursor to hardware based. This needs to be tested.

- Updated : Invasion unit number starts small and then increases per invasion.

- Updated : Invasion unit number coming through at any time during battle starts small and increases per invasion.

- Updated : Controller no longer works for movement when use controller option is not turned on.

I have just came back from Taipei game show and I sure have a lot to update! So I will do this over the next few days.

The first one is to sort out the initial stairs room. 

------

BETA BUILD

Release Note : Version 1.0.1.2  29 Jan 2016

- Fixed : Scroll bar ui bug with all queue systems.

- Fixed : Wrong durability stats for items going in and out of reserch queue.

- Updated : Increased speed of repair, repair speed also depends on the amount of max durability that the item can be repaired to.

- Updated : Possible increase of performance for low and middle light quality settings.

- Updated : Experimental ambient lighting tied to the elevator switch. If level doesn't have one, it is considered to be turned on. This feature will work on random maps even on the old save games, but for the non random maps, it will only work for a new game, since the stats are saved.

Show at Taiwan is going well. very busy place and many many people. It would have been better if it was b2c, but I still get to see some of the other cool indie games. 

------

Release Note : Version 1.0.1.1  27 Jan 2016

- Fixed : Some non repairable items such as filters being able to place in the repair bay.

- Fixed : Possible very short invasion time terms.

Everyone!

I will be attending TaiPie Game Show 2016 and be hosting a smll booth there showing Subterrain.

I will be gone from 27th till 30th and my usual update will be slow during this time.

I hope everyone at show like Subterrain!

------

- Update : Slightly increased rate of dump and ♥♥♥♥ needs building up.

- Fixed : When West travel to the Central control for an invasion battle, if West dies during the fight, loaded level still thinks it is in the middle of  
invasion battle.

- Fixed : Destroyed core showing as -1 durability in the core slot UI, instead of empty item.

------

notes.title: Version 0.7.5.0 major public update
notes.notes:
Version 0.7.5.0 major public update

Release Note : Version 0.7.5.0   01 June 2015

Major public update.

Survival 

- New : Sitting
http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Sit.jpg
West can sit on the chair, sofa or bench. Stamina recovery rate is increased while sitting.

- New : Sleeping
http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Sleep.jpg
West can sleep on the bed. Time will pass quicker and sleepiness condition will improve. Rest status which gives reduced stamina requirement condition will be invoked upon waking up.

- New : Drink from a tap
http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Tap.jpg
West can drink from a tap at the risk of contamination. It has limited supply of water and it does not refill.


Combat

- New : Dodge move
http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Dodge.jpg
West has new move to dodge or quick step away from danger by pressing space bar and the movement keys. Dodge move will drain his stamina.

- New : Shield
http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Shield.jpg
West can block attacks by equipping power pack and hold click right mouse button. It can absorb up to 50% of incoming damage. Shield will drain energy from power pack when it is turned on and drains extra energy when it is hit. Damage absorption amount and their effects are very much in open for development. 

- New : Power melee attack
http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_PowerAttack.jpg
Melee attack move has changed from left mouse click to hold left mouse click and then release. Longer you hold the left mouse button more power West gathers before he releases to strike. You can gather the power up to 2 seconds which will result in 2x damage.


Graphics

- New : New style of fog.
http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_NewFog.jpg
Fog area that are not visible to West is now represented by gray of the game background. West still needs to explore the area with his vision plus some lights to be able to unveil the fog so any undiscovered area will still be represented by the darkness. This may reduce some immersion feelings but we think it improves the overall visuals quite a bit. We can also introduce the pure black fog as before through option or on the game difficulty selection.

- New : Cocoon update.
http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Cocoon.jpg
Cocoons are updated with the new sprites. Their physics behavior have also changed. Now they will be anchored at the fixed point on the ground, and only their core will move about. This will make player less likely get stuck by the cocoons. Their death effect has been updated too. Future plan for the cocoon is that when they die, they can spawn some mutants and when you go near them they may occasionally attack you with some kind of tentacles.

- New : Decals.
http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Decal.jpg
We have started placing much needed decals on the map. This is part of the ongoing environment improvements. Soon, we want to turn these maggots into some kind of bio traps and add other types of dangers to the environment.

- New : Lighting option
http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_LightOption.jpg
New graphics option - Lighting quality. (Low, Medium, High) This option can be used by a lower spec computer such as laptop with Intel HD 4000 graphics card to improve game performance. For a normal gaming pc, it shouldn’t have much effects at all and you can just set it to high. But with a low spec computer that has low GPU memory bandwidth, this option can improve game performance.
 
- New : Shop UI
http://www.castorlee.com/Subterrain/Images/Subterrain_Shop.jpg
3D Printer shop UI has changed. Now, it accepts proper access cards as well as discount coupons. Access cards and coupons can be found throughout the game.

Other Notes :

- Changed : Max stamina is increased by 300%
- Melee attack kill can result in a better biomass drop yield.
- Added knock back force on melee attacks.
- Tutorial tips needs to be updated.
- Balancing needs to be tweaked as we have just introduced the new features.
- We have asked Valve for price adjustment approval. We have no idea when it will be approved.

notes.title: Version 0.7.3.7 released with new save options!
notes.notes:
This release version has a new save options.

Ability to use these save options will be changed per difficulty options (which we are working on) but for now, we have unlocked for current mode.

Release Note : Version 0.7.3.7   12 May 2015

- Fixed : Scutum bug (can't enter rooms)

- Fixed : Pressing journal key (default j) opens journal when there was none.

- New : Save game in pause menu.

- New : Save points in the level to save the game.

http://www.pixellore.com/Subterrain/Images/SavePoint.jpg

- New : Option to continue from last save game when you die without going back to main menu.

- New : Large power charger for terminal levels and new smaller ones at the hub levels. Max charge level for them are 1500 and 700 respectively. This should make energy requirement a bit easier.

- New : Keyboard remapping! This isn't fully GUI featured experience, but now you can remap the keyboard by changing settings.xml file (such as : C:\Users\saehoon\AppData\LocalLow\Pixellore\Subterrain\Settings\settings.xml ) If you break the setting by entering the same key or anything else, the game will overwrite the settings file with default one.

- Changed : medical item spawning chance at the medical bays.

On the next version, we will try to introduce first difficulty level selection and ability to skip tutorial levels.

Because of many core changes, your old save game may/may not work with this version. Thanks for your understanding.

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Subterrain version 0.7.3.2 with level map feature!
notes.notes:
Version 0.7.3.2 has experimental level map feature!

Some of you asked for mini map, level map. And we listened. But features like this you will never know if it will help to make better game or not if you don't try it.

So we tried it. It is first version and still in experiment stage so there could be some bugs and it doesn't look very pretty.

Press 'M' button to open map.

The map is based on current in game fog system. So the featured icons such as crafting 3d printer and research like won't show up if you have not discovered it yet.

We are thinking of maybe add some kind of feature where you can download the vague location of the locations for the cost of some of your resources. (Credits , whatever)

As always , feedback is welcome and please test them if you can.

Thanks.
